voice.summary: Harbourlight sounds like a lighthouse keeper with a pager: calm, specific and a little salty. It promises to know the moment your site goes down and to say so clearly.
dos: Talk about sites going down and coming back in plain terms
Name plans with boat names and give exact prices
Use sea metaphors sparingly, one per page
donts: Do not use fear of downtime as a hook
Never hide currency or billing period

taglines: Know the moment your site goes down
Alerts that arrive before customers do
Pick the plan that fits your harbour
boilerplate: Harbourlight is an uptime monitoring service for small websites, with SSL checks and instant alerts on every plan, from a solo Dinghy to a team-ready Schooner.

microcopy.success: Plan chosen. Your first check runs now.
microcopy.error: Could not switch currency. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No monitors yet. Add your first site.

logo.note: A pulse line symbolises uptime checks and reads like a lighthouse signal.
